title: Reusable HTML blocks
problem: The same delivery note or banner had to be retyped on every page, and nothing could go into the footer or menus.
now: Blocks made with the page editor are placed in headers, layouts, mega menus, the footer and the product tab; the list shows where each is used.
steps: Open Phone deals and change its text, then Save
Open the store and hover Phones: the mega menu shows the new text
Back in the list, delete a used block: it warns where it is used first

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
